overview: S21 delivers a full chunk column to the client, and it is the transport that makes xray and world-downloader cheating possible. Server-side anticheats approach it from two directions: xray checks score ore-breaking behavior (BAC XRayCheck, AntiCheatPlus XRayListener, Negativity XRayProtocol), sentinel modules neutralize world downloaders at the plugin-message level (Photon WorldDownloaderSentinel), and simulation anticheats parse the chunk bytes into a compensated world so their movement and phase checks see the same blocks the client sees (Grim PacketWorldReaderEight, Hydro WorldTracker, Truthful CompensatedWorld, Kauri Chunk and World, Intave block caches). The corpus for S21 is dominated by the replication side, because every block-based check depends on it.

checks.name: XRayCheck (BasicAntiCheat)
checks.purpose: Ghost-block xray heuristic: spawn fake ore blocks in front of the player and flag anyone who breaks them.
checks.how_it_works: On BlockBreakEvent, when the player breaks an ore, the check walks up to 9 blocks in the player's facing direction and replaces a buried stone block with the same ore type, recording it as a ghost block with a proximity counter. On PlayerMoveEvent, ghost blocks that the player approaches too often and then breaks (5 or more close encounters) fail the check; sneaking while standing over a block also registers it. The check is marked as heavy beta in the config.
checks.detects: Xray users who path straight to ores through solid rock and break ghost blocks that were never visible.
checks.variations: AntiCheatPlus XRayListener and XRayTracker score ore ratios per player instead of ghost blocks; Negativity XRayProtocol runs a similar ore-ratio heuristic; Observer ChestESP is the render-side cousin of the same idea.

checks.name: XRayListener and XRayTracker (AntiCheatPlus)
checks.purpose: Ore-ratio xray detection: players who mine far more ores per total blocks than the server average are flagged.
checks.how_it_works: BlockBreakEvent feeds per-ore counters (diamond, iron, gold, lapis, redstone) and a total block counter into XRayTracker for every checked player; creative players are skipped unless checkCreativeXRay is enabled. XRayStats snapshots the counts and the scheduled XRay checker compares ratios against the server baseline at the configured alert interval.
checks.detects: Xray users whose ore-to-block ratio is statistically above legitimate mining.
checks.variations: Negativity XRayProtocol uses the same ratio idea; BAC XRayCheck detects via ghost blocks instead; LightAntiCheat hooks unloaded-chunk movement (UnloadedChunkListener) to catch players walking through terrain that should not exist.

checks.name: PacketWorldReaderEight (Grim)
checks.purpose: Parse the raw S21 chunk data bytes into Grim's compensated world so simulation checks see the exact blocks the client received.
checks.how_it_works: BasePacketWorldReader dispatches the outbound chunk packets: handleMapChunk reads the chunk x/z, ground-up flag, section mask and size, decodes each 16-section column with the 1.8 endian-flipped palette reader, skips biome and light arrays, and merges the result into the compensated world cache with the transaction id. The 1.9+ and 1.18 readers are separate implementations; unloads are queued via removeChunkLater.
checks.detects: Feeds ground, collision and phase simulation; without it, ghost-block and phase cheats would read a stale world.
checks.variations: Hydro WorldTracker and Truthful CompensatedWorld keep the same compensated cache with chunk snapshots; Kauri World and Chunk classes store WrappedBlock arrays; Intave BlockCaches and ChunkAccessPatcher build the block cache for its physics simulator; Artemis CachedWorld does the same for its emulator.

checks.name: WorldDownloaderSentinel (Photon)
checks.purpose: Detect WorldDownloader mods and disable their chunk caching, entity saving and container saving over the wdl plugin-message channel.
checks.how_it_works: Registers the wdl/init and wdl/control plugin-message channels. When a client announces itself on wdl|INIT, the module answers on wdl|CONTROL with two packets that disable future functionality, general saving, chunk caching, entity and tile-entity saving and container saving per config, then runs the standard sentinel detection. Chunk data (S21 and S26) is the mod's raw material, so the module closes the hole at the channel handshake.
checks.detects: WorldDownloader clients that would otherwise persist every chunk the server sends.
checks.variations: No other anticheat in the corpus speaks the wdl channels; Negativity (WorldRegionBypass) and LightAntiCheat approximate the same protection with region bypass and unloaded-chunk checks.
